caption: The cord of a running hairdryer is pulled out of the socket, and the dryer falls silent and stops blowing.

sa.check: A hairdryer runs: its blower is on.
Its cord is pulled out of the socket.
The order is running, pull, stopped.

pc.expect: The blowing stops at the moment the plug leaves the socket, and only then, even though the switch is still on.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the dryer blows on to the end of the clip; or the dryer stops before the plug moves; or the dryer stops with the plug still seated; or the airflow stops but the heating element glows on.

pc.expect: Once unplugged the dryer stays stopped; it does not start again while the plug is out.
pc.fail: The dryer starts blowing again with the plug out; or blows in bursts after the pull; or the plug jumps back into the socket; or the switch moves by itself.

pc.expect: Anything in the airflow flutters while the dryer runs and settles once it stops.
pc.fail: Hair or ribbons stream after the plug is out; or nothing in front of the nozzle moves while the dryer runs; or the flutter blows toward the nozzle.
pc.precondition: Hair, ribbons or other light items are in the airflow.

pc.expect: The cord follows the plug: it slackens and drops once the plug is free and stays attached at both ends.
pc.fail: The cord stretches like elastic; or stands rigid in the air after the plug is out; or floats.

pc.expect: One dryer, one cord, one plug, one socket; the plug leaves the socket whole; nothing passes through the wall.
pc.fail: The plug vanishes or a second plug appears; or the plug passes through the wall; or the cord splits or detaches; or the dryer changes shape.

pc.expect: The dryer's colour, the cord and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The dryer changes colour; or the cord changes colour; or the room's contents rearrange.

note: The dryer falling silent is sound and is not judged; stopping is read from the airflow's effect or the fan blur ending.
